<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>
<title>Amir Sulaiman Rumel</title>
<meta content="cover" name="claude:viewport-fit-sides"/>
<meta content="Education Officer at World Vision Bangladesh. Education in Emergencies, teacher capacity development, monitoring and reporting, Cox's Bazar." name="description"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wdth,wght@12..96,75..100,400..800&amp;family=Public+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
/* Layout: sticky site bar, seven pages switched by hash. Every page opens on a ruled exercise-book band;
   the home headline sits on its own writing lines. Pencil yellow is the single bright note. */
:root{
  --font-display:'Bricolage Grotesque','Hind Siliguri','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Public Sans','Hind Siliguri','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-bn:'Hind Siliguri','Noto Sans Bengali',sans-serif;
  --pencil:#F4C430;
  --band-bg:#0E3A40; --band-fg:#EAF4F2; --band-muted:#A9C9C5; --band-line:rgba(234,244,242,.14);
  --bg:#F2F6F5; --surface:#FFFFFF; --surface-2:#E7EFED; --fg:#0F2326; --muted:#4A6064; --line:#CDDAD8;
  --accent:#0E5560; --on-accent:#FFFFFF; --focus:#0B6E7C; --mark:#FBE08A;
  --bar-a:#14505A; --bar-b:#3C9AA8; --bar-study:#F4C430; --bar-study-line:#8A6A00;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --band-bg:#0D3238; --bg:#0A1A1D; --surface:#102529; --surface-2:#153035; --fg:#E6F0EE; --muted:#9DB6B3; --line:#244146;
    --accent:#F4C430; --on-accent:#0A1A1D; --focus:#F4C430; --mark:#4A3F12;
    --bar-a:#2E7F8A; --bar-b:#7CC4CC; --bar-study-line:#F4C430; color-scheme:dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --band-bg:#0D3238; --bg:#0A1A1D; --surface:#102529; --surface-2:#153035; --fg:#E6F0EE; --muted:#9DB6B3; --line:#244146;
  --accent:#F4C430; --on-accent:#0A1A1D; --focus:#F4C430; --mark:#4A3F12;
  --bar-a:#2E7F8A; --bar-b:#7CC4CC; --bar-study-line:#F4C430; color-scheme:dark;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font:400 16px/1.65 var(--font-body);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:var(--band-bg)}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.015em;text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
p{margin:0}
a{color:var(--accent)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
.band :focus-visible,.site :focus-visible{outline-color:var(--pencil)}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin-inline:auto;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}

/* site bar */
.site{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:var(--band-bg);color:var(--band-fg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--band-line)}
.site .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:58px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand{font:700 1.05rem var(--font-display);color:inherit;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.nav{display:flex;gap:2px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;margin-left:auto;min-width:0}
.nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.nav a{padding:.55rem .8rem;color:var(--band-muted);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:6px}
.nav a:hover{color:#fff}
.nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--pencil)}
@media (max-width:860px){.nav{margin-left:0;width:100%;padding-bottom:4px}}

/* bands */
.band{background:var(--band-bg);color:var(--band-fg)}
.ruled{--lh:1.16;line-height:var(--lh);background-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent calc(var(--lh) * 1em - 3px),rgba(244,196,48,.6) calc(var(--lh) * 1em - 3px),rgba(244,196,48,.6) calc(var(--lh) * 1em));background-size:100% calc(var(--lh) * 1em)}
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-block:clamp(40px,7vw,88px) clamp(72px,9vw,112px)}
.hero::before,.pagehead::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 31px,rgba(255,255,255,.055) 31px);background-size:100% 32px;pointer-events:none}
@media (min-width:1240px){.hero::after,.pagehead::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:56px;width:2px;background:rgba(244,196,48,.3)}}
.hero .wrap,.pagehead .wrap{position:relative}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(220px,310px);gap:clamp(28px,5vw,72px);align-items:center}
@media (max-width:760px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.portrait{max-width:250px}}
.who{color:var(--band-muted);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:18px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.35rem,6.4vw,4.5rem);font-variation-settings:"wdth" 88,"opsz" 96;margin-bottom:26px}
.lede{max-width:56ch;font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--band-fg);opacity:.92}
.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:30px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;padding:.8rem 1.3rem;border-radius:8px;font:700 .95rem var(--font-body);text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer}
.btn-pencil{background:var(--pencil);color:#10251F}
.btn-line{border-color:rgba(234,244,242,.45);color:var(--band-fg)}
.btn-solid{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}
.btn-quiet{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--fg);background:transparent}
.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.07)}
.portrait{margin:0;width:100%}
.portrait img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 30%;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--band-bg),0 0 0 5px var(--pencil)}
.pagehead{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-block:clamp(32px,5vw,60px)}
.pagehead h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.3rem);font-variation-settings:"wdth" 90,"opsz" 80;margin-bottom:16px;max-width:22ch}
.pagehead p{max-width:62ch;color:var(--band-muted);font-size:1.05rem}

/* report panel on home */
.report{margin-top:-52px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.report-panel{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:clamp(20px,3vw,32px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:28px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(8,32,36,.14)}
.report-panel>div{min-width:0}
.report-panel h2{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--pencil);display:inline-block}
.report-panel p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.report-panel p strong{color:var(--fg)}

/* sections */
.section{padding-block:clamp(40px,6vw,72px)}
.section.alt{background:var(--surface-2)}
.section h2{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3.4vw,2.3rem);margin-bottom:10px}
.lead{color:var(--muted);max-width:64ch}
.head{margin-bottom:30px}
.small{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}
.page{min-width:0}
.page:not([hidden]){animation:pagein .35s ease}
@keyframes pagein{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* gantt */
.gscroll{overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px}
.g{--lab:190px;position:relative;min-width:680px}
.g-axis,.g-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:var(--lab) minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center}
.g-axis{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.g-axis .yrs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr)}
.g-axis .yrs span{padding-left:4px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.g-row{padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.g-label{padding-right:14px;min-width:0}
.g-label b{display:block;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.3}
.g-label span{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.g-track{position:relative;height:26px;background-image:linear-gradient(to right,var(--line) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:10% 100%}
.g-bar{position:absolute;top:3px;height:20px;border-radius:4px}
.g-bar.a{background:var(--bar-a)}
.g-bar.b{background:var(--bar-b)}
.g-bar.study{background:var(--bar-study);border:2px solid var(--bar-study-line)}
.g-tick{position:absolute;top:0;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--fg);background:var(--bar-study);border-radius:3px;padding:2px 5px;line-height:1.2;top:3px;border:2px solid var(--bar-study-line);color:#10251F}
.g-over{position:absolute;left:var(--lab);right:0;top:0;bottom:0;pointer-events:none}
.g-now{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;border-left:2px dashed var(--accent)}
.g-now i{position:absolute;top:-2px;left:6px;font:700 .72rem var(--font-body);font-style:normal;color:var(--accent)}
.legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;margin-top:14px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:22px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle}

/* rows list (programmes) */
.prog{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.3fr);gap:6px 28px;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.prog:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.prog h3{font-size:1.15rem}
.prog .tag{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
@media (max-width:760px){.prog{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}

/* cta */
.cta{padding-block:clamp(40px,6vw,64px)}
.cta .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.2vw,2.1rem);max-width:24ch}
.cta p{color:var(--band-muted);margin-top:8px;max-width:52ch}

/* about */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(28px,5vw,64px);align-items:start}
@media (max-width:860px){.split{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.prose p{margin-bottom:1.1em;max-width:66ch}
.prose h2{margin-top:1.6em}
.prose h2:first-child{margin-top:0}
.facts{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:22px}
.facts dl{margin:0}
.facts dt{font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px}
.facts dt:first-child{margin-top:0}
.facts dd{margin:2px 0 0;font-weight:500}
.how{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:26px}
.how h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.how p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.recs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:28px}
.rec{margin:0;padding-top:18px;border-top:3px solid var(--pencil)}
.rec p{font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:12px}
.rec footer{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted)}
.rec footer b{color:var(--fg)}

/* expertise */
.focus3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:20px}
.focus3 div{background:var(--band-bg);color:var(--band-fg);border-radius:12px;padding:22px}
.focus3 h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.focus3 p{color:var(--band-muted);font-size:.95rem}
.exp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:34px 44px}
.exp{min-width:0;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.exp h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.exp>p{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px}
.exp h4{font:700 .85rem var(--font-body);margin-bottom:6px}
.exp ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.1em;font-size:.93rem}
.exp li{margin-bottom:3px}
.tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.tools span{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:.3rem .7rem;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500}

/* experience */
.role{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.role:last-of-type{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.role summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px minmax(0,1fr) 20px;gap:6px 24px;padding:20px 0;align-items:baseline}
.role summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.role .when{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.role h3{font-size:1.25rem}
.role .org{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin-top:2px}
.chev{width:10px;height:10px;border-right:2px solid var(--fg);border-bottom:2px solid var(--fg);transform:rotate(45deg);justify-self:end;align-self:center;transition:transform .2s}
.role[open] .chev{transform:rotate(-135deg)}
.role .body{padding:0 0 26px 174px}
.role .body ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.1em;max-width:70ch}
.role .body li{margin-bottom:6px}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .role summary{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 20px}
  .role .when{grid-column:1/-1}
  .role .body{padding-left:0}
}
.partners{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.partners span{border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:.4rem .95rem;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;background:var(--surface)}

/* education */
.now-card{background:var(--band-bg);color:var(--band-fg);border-radius:12px;padding:clamp(20px,3vw,30px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:14px 28px;align-items:center}
.now-card h2{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.6vw,1.7rem);margin-bottom:6px}
.now-card p{color:var(--band-muted);max-width:60ch}
.now-card .badge{background:var(--pencil);color:#10251F;font-weight:700;border-radius:99px;padding:.4rem 1rem;font-size:.9rem;white-space:nowrap}
@media (max-width:640px){.now-card{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.now-card .badge{justify-self:start}}
.deg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.8fr);gap:6px 24px;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.deg:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.deg .y{color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.deg b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.08rem}
.deg .r{color:var(--muted);font-size:.93rem}
@media (max-width:760px){.deg{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.recent{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:18px}
.recent div{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:18px}
.recent h3{font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.recent p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px}
.chip{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--fg);padding:.45rem .95rem;border-radius:99px;font:600 .86rem var(--font-body);cursor:pointer}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.count{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.tablewrap{overflow-x:auto}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:560px;font-size:.93rem}
th{text-align:left;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);padding:8px 12px 8px 0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line)}
td{padding:11px 12px 11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top}
td:last-child,th:last-child{white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* services */
.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:18px}
.svc{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.svc h3{font-size:1.1rem}
.svc p{font-size:.95rem}
.svc .built{margin-top:auto;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.svc .built b{color:var(--fg)}
.pending{background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}

/* contact */
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:clamp(28px,5vw,60px);align-items:start}
@media (max-width:860px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.crow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:4px 12px;align-items:center;padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.crow:last-of-type{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.crow small{grid-column:1/-1;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-size:.82rem}
.crow span.v{font-weight:500;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.copy{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--fg);border-radius:6px;padding:.3rem .75rem;font:600 .82rem var(--font-body);cursor:pointer}
.copy:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.builder{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:clamp(18px,3vw,28px)}
.builder h2{font-size:1.4rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;margin-top:14px}
.field label{font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem}
select,textarea{width:100%;font:400 .95rem var(--font-body);color:var(--fg);background:var(--bg);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:.6rem .7rem}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:84px}
.bn{font-family:var(--font-bn);font-size:1.05rem}
footer.site-foot{padding-block:28px calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
/* language toggle and Bangla typography */
.lang{order:2;border:1.5px solid rgba(234,244,242,.4);background:transparent;color:var(--band-fg);border-radius:99px;padding:.35rem .9rem;font:700 .85rem var(--font-body);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.lang:hover{background:rgba(234,244,242,.1)}
.nav{order:1}
@media (max-width:860px){.lang{margin-left:auto}.nav{order:3}}
:root[lang="bn"]{--font-display:'Hind Siliguri','Bricolage Grotesque','Segoe UI',sans-serif;--font-body:'Hind Siliguri','Public Sans','Segoe UI',sans-serif}
:root[lang="bn"] body{line-height:1.8}
:root[lang="bn"] h1,:root[lang="bn"] h2,:root[lang="bn"] h3,:root[lang="bn"] h4{letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.38}
:root[lang="bn"] .ruled{--lh:1.4;line-height:1.4}
:root[lang="bn"] .hero h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,5.2vw,3.7rem)}
:root[lang="bn"] .pagehead h1{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4.4vw,2.8rem)}

/* field gallery */
.shots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:22px}
.shot{margin:0;min-width:0}
.shot img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-2)}
.shot figcaption{margin-top:10px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted)}
.lg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
</style>
<header class="site">
<div class="wrap">
<a class="brand" data-k="0" href="#home">Amir Sulaiman Rumel</a>
<nav aria-label="Pages" class="nav">
<a data-k="1" data-r="home" href="#home">Home</a>
<a data-k="2" data-r="about" href="#about">About</a>
<a data-k="3" data-r="expertise" href="#expertise">Expertise</a>
<a data-k="4" data-r="experience" href="#experience">Experience</a>
<a data-k="5" data-r="education" href="#education">Education</a>
<a data-k="6" data-r="services" href="#services">Services</a>
<a data-k="7" data-r="contact" href="#contact">Contact</a>
</nav>
<button aria-label="Switch language" class="lang" id="lang" type="button">বাংলা</button>
</div>
</header>
<main>
<!-- ============ HOME ============ -->
<div class="page" id="p-home">
<section class="band hero">
<div class="wrap hero-grid">
<div>
<p class="who" data-k="9">Amir Sulaiman Rumel, Education Officer at World Vision Bangladesh</p>
<h1 class="ruled" data-k="10">Keeping children learning through displacement.</h1>

<!-- ============ ABOUT ============ -->
<div class="page" hidden="" id="p-about">
<section class="band pagehead">
<div class="wrap">
<h1 class="ruled" data-k="55">From law chambers to learning centres.</h1>
<p data-k="56">I trained as a lawyer, then spent the next eight years helping children and teachers in displacement settings keep learning.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="section">
<div class="wrap split">
<div class="prose">
<h2 data-k="57">My story</h2>
<p data-k="58">I went to school in Cox's Bazar and studied law at City University in Dhaka, finishing an LL.B in 2017 and an LL.M in 2018. At Shams Law Chamber I drafted contracts, agreements and internal policies, advised management and worked with senior lawyers on cases at the Dhaka Judge Court.</p>
<p data-k="59">In 2019 I moved into humanitarian work as a Field Registration Assistant with UNHCR in Camp 16, Ukhiya. The work was about accuracy and dignity: interviewing families, recording their details in proGres and the biometrics system, and helping registration run smoothly.</p>
<p data-k="60">In 2020 I joined Jagorani Chakra Foundation on the UNICEF-partnered ERC project in Camps 5 and 6. I visited homes to keep learners attending, supervised teachers, ran ASER+ assessments and trained mentors and facilitators. In 2023 I joined World Vision Bangladesh as Training Organizer, Education, and in November 2025 became Education Officer.</p>
<h2 data-k="61">What I want to build</h2>
<p data-k="62">My mission is to strengthen learning opportunities for vulnerable children and communities through evidence-based education work, teacher empowerment and partnerships between communities, government and international organisations.</p>
<p data-k="63">My legal background still shows in my work. It helps me read agreements and compliance requirements closely, and to document programme work in a way donors and authorities can trust.</p>
<h2 data-k="64">Beyond the job</h2>
<p data-k="65">I chair a local youth development foundation. On LinkedIn I share field learning and community activity, including a Leadership Training 2026 organised by Coxian Express and a tree-planting drive, and I write in Bangla and English.</p>
</div>
<aside class="facts">

<div class="how">
<div><h3 data-k="82">I go to the centre</h3><p data-k="83">Regular visits, home visits to keep attendance up, and direct support to the teacher in the room.</p></div>
<div><h3 data-k="84">I build relationships early</h3><p data-k="85">Camp-in-Charge offices, Education Sector leads, UEO and DPEO, school management committees, majhis and block committees.</p></div>
<div><h3 data-k="86">I write things down</h3><p data-k="87">Daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual reports in donor and cluster formats, plus case studies and success stories.</p></div>
<div><h3 data-k="88">I adjust to feedback</h3><p data-k="89">Programme plans change when assessments and community feedback say they should.</p></div>

<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu"><h3 data-k="346">Training design and facilitation</h3><p data-k="347">Workshops, coaching sessions and training-of-trainers programmes planned around the people in the room, with materials and follow-up.</p><p class="built" data-k="348"><b>Built on:</b> Teaching and Learning Circles, teacher coaching, UNICEF ToT (2020)</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu"><h3 data-k="349">Curriculum and training materials</h3><p data-k="350">Lesson plans, facilitator guides and IEC and BCC materials, including content that includes children with disabilities.</p><p class="built" data-k="351"><b>Built on:</b> IEC and BCC materials at World Vision, GIEP materials training (2022), disability-inclusive curriculum training (2024)</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu"><h3 data-k="352">Monitoring and evaluation support</h3><p data-k="353">Monitoring tools, learning assessments and progress tracking against implementation plans.</p><p class="built" data-k="354"><b>Built on:</b> ASER+ assessment, MEAL training (2021), field monitoring of teaching quality</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu biz"><h3 data-k="355">Data collection and analysis</h3><p data-k="356">Survey and assessment set-up in Kobo, data cleaning and short summaries of findings.</p><p class="built" data-k="357"><b>Built on:</b> Kobo and data management training (2022), proGres and biometrics data entry at UNHCR, MS Excel</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo"><h3 data-k="358">Report and case-study writing</h3><p data-k="359">Reports in donor or cluster formats, plus case studies and success stories that read clearly.</p><p class="built" data-k="360"><b>Built on:</b> Daily to annual reporting at World Vision Bangladesh and Jagorani Chakra Foundation</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo"><h3 data-k="361">Proposal and concept-note drafting</h3><p data-k="362">Drafting support for education and protection proposals, built from your programme data and context.</p><p class="built" data-k="363"><b>Built on:</b> Needs assessments, situation analyses and service mapping; programme reporting</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu"><h3 data-k="364">Project documentation and coordination</h3><p data-k="365">Work plans, meeting notes, stakeholder mapping and follow-up with partners and local authorities.</p><p class="built" data-k="366"><b>Built on:</b> Coordination with Camp-in-Charge offices, the Education Sector, UEO and school management committees</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu"><h3 data-k="367">Research and needs assessment</h3><p data-k="368">Desk research, community assessments and situation analysis for education programmes.</p><p class="built" data-k="369"><b>Built on:</b> Needs assessments and situation analysis at World Vision, ASER+, service mapping</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu biz"><h3 data-k="370">Document and presentation formatting</h3><p data-k="371">Clean, consistent reports, CVs and slide decks, ready to send to a donor or an employer.</p><p class="built" data-k="372"><b>Built on:</b> Office applications training and years of formal reporting</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu biz"><h3 data-k="373">Bangla and English content writing</h3><p data-k="374">Articles, LinkedIn posts and profile or CV writing in Bangla and English.</p><p class="built" data-k="375"><b>Built on:</b> Basic Journalism training (2016), regular LinkedIn writing in both languages</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo biz"><h3 data-k="376">Policy and agreement drafting</h3><p data-k="377">Plain-language drafting and review of agreements and internal policies for compliance.</p><p class="built" data-k="378"><b>Built on:</b> LL.B and LL.M, and drafting contracts, agreements and policies at Shams Law Chamber</p></article>
<article class="svc" data-aud="ngo edu"><h3 data-k="379">Education programme consulting</h3><p data-k="380">Advice on setting up or strengthening early childhood and teacher-support programmes in displacement and host settings.</p><p class="built" data-k="381"><b>Built on:</b> ECE and Myanmar Curriculum delivery, learning-centre management, system strengthening with UEO and camp management</p></article>
</div>

কক্সবাজার, বাংলাদেশ। হালনাগাদ: নভেম্বর ২০২৬।"};
  var lang='en';
  try{ lang=(localStorage.getItem('lang')==='bn')?'bn':'en'; }catch(e){}
  function tr(en,bn){ return lang==='bn'?bn:en; }
  var keyed=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-k]'));
  var EN={};
  keyed.forEach(function(el){ EN[el.getAttribute('data-k')]=el.innerHTML; });
  var phNote=document.getElementById('b-note');
  var PH={en:'Programme, location, number of participants, deliverables',bn:'কর্মসূচি, স্থান, অংশগ্রহণকারীর সংখ্যা, প্রত্যাশিত ফলাফল'};

  /* career chart, drawn to scale */
  var FROM=2017, TO=2027, NOW=2026.9;
  var rows=[
    {l:['Shams Law Chamber','শামস ল চেম্বার'],s:['Practitioner lawyer','সহকারী আইনজীবী'],b:[{a:2017+7/12,z:2018+9/12,k:'a',t:['Practitioner Lawyer, Aug 2017 to Sep 2018','আইনজীবী, আগস্ট ২০১৭ থেকে সেপ্টেম্বর ২০১৮']}]},
    {l:['UNHCR','ইউএনএইচসিআর'],s:['Field registration','ফিল্ড নিবন্ধন'],b:[{a:2019+5/12,z:2020,k:'a',t:['Field Registration Assistant, Jun to Dec 2019','ফিল্ড রেজিস্ট্রেশন অ্যাসিস্ট্যান্ট, জুন থেকে ডিসেম্বর ২০১৯']}]},
    {l:['Jagorani Chakra Foundation','জাগরণী চক্র ফাউন্ডেশন'],s:['Education programmes','শিক্ষা কর্মসূচি'],b:[{a:2020,z:2022+11/12,k:'a',t:['Program Organizer, LC Education, Jan 2020 to Nov 2022','প্রোগ্রাম অর্গানাইজার, এলসি শিক্ষা, জানুয়ারি ২০২০ থেকে নভেম্বর ২০২২']},{a:2022+11/12,z:2023+10/12,k:'b',t:['Program Organizer, MCP Education, Dec 2022 to Oct 2023','প্রোগ্রাম অর্গানাইজার, এমসিপি শিক্ষা, ডিসেম্বর ২০২২ থেকে অক্টোবর ২০২৩']}]},
    {l:['World Vision Bangladesh','ওয়ার্ল্ড ভিশন বাংলাদেশ'],s:['Education programmes','শিক্ষা কর্মসূচি'],b:[{a:2023+10/12,z:2025+10/12,k:'a',t:['Training Organizer, Education, Nov 2023 to Oct 2025','ট্রেনিং অর্গানাইজার, শিক্ষা, নভেম্বর ২০২৩ থেকে অক্টোবর ২০২৫']},{a:2025+10/12,z:NOW,k:'b',t:['Education Officer, Nov 2025 to present','এডুকেশন অফিসার, নভেম্বর ২০২৫ থেকে বর্তমান']}]},
    {l:['Study','পড়াশোনা'],s:['Degrees','ডিগ্রি'],b:[{a:2021,z:2023,k:'study',t:['B.Ed, 2021 to 2022','বি.এড, ২০২১ থেকে ২০২২']},{a:2025+5/12,z:NOW,k:'study',t:['M.Ed, in progress','এম.এড, চলমান']}],ticks:[{at:2017.5,t:['LL.B','এলএলবি']},{at:2018.5,t:['LL.M','এলএলএম']}]}
  ];
  function pct(v){ return ((v-FROM)/(TO-FROM)*100).toFixed(2)+'%'; }
  function drawGantt(){
    var i=(lang==='bn')?1:0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-gantt]').forEach(function(box){
      var h='<div class="g-axis"><div></div><div class="yrs">';
      for(var y=FROM;y<TO;y++) h+='<span>'+y+'</span>';
      h+='</div></div>';
      rows.forEach(function(r){
        h+='<div class="g-row"><div class="g-label"><b>'+r.l[i]+'</b><span>'+r.s[i]+'</span></div><div class="g-track">';
        r.b.forEach(function(b){ h+='<div class="g-bar '+b.k+'" style="left:'+pct(b.a)+';width:'+((b.z-b.a)/(TO-FROM)*100).toFixed(2)+'%" title="'+b.t[i]+'" role="img" aria-label="'+b.t[i]+'"></div>'; });
        (r.ticks||[]).forEach(function(t){ h+='<div class="g-tick" style="left:'+pct(t.at)+'">'+t.t[i]+'</div>'; });
        h+='</div></div>';
      });
      h+='<div class="g-over"><div class="g-now" style="left:'+pct(NOW)+'"><i>'+tr('Now','এখন')+'</i></div></div>';
      box.innerHTML=h;
    });
  }

  /* filters */
  var groups=[];
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-filter]').forEach(function(group){
    var target=document.querySelector(group.dataset.filter);
    var attr=group.dataset.attr;
    var counter=document.querySelector(group.dataset.count);
    var items=target.querySelectorAll('['+'data-'+attr+']');
    var cur='all';
    function apply(){
      var n=0;
      items.forEach(function(i){
        var ok=(cur==='all')||(i.getAttribute('data-'+attr)||'').split(' ').indexOf(cur)>=0;
        i.hidden=!ok; if(ok) n++;
      });
      counter.textContent=tr('Showing '+n+' of '+items.length,'মোট '+items.length+'টির মধ্যে '+n+'টি দেখানো হচ্ছে');
    }
    group.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(function(c){
      c.addEventListener('click',function(){
        cur=c.dataset.v;
        group.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(function(o){ o.setAttribute('aria-pressed',o===c?'true':'false'); });
        apply();
      });
    });
    groups.push(apply);
    apply();
  });

  /* copy helpers */
  function selectEl(el){
    try{
      if(el.select){ el.focus(); el.select(); return; }
      var r=document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(el);
      var s=window.getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function copyFrom(el,done,fail){
    var text=(el.tagName==='TEXTAREA')?el.value:el.textContent;
    var p=null;
    try{ p=navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); }catch(e){}
    if(p&&p.then){ p.then(done,function(){ selectEl(el); fail(); }); }
    else { selectEl(el); fail(); }
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.copy').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var el=document.querySelector(btn.dataset.copy);
      var label=btn.innerHTML;
      copyFrom(el,function(){ btn.textContent=tr('Copied','কপি হয়েছে'); setTimeout(function(){btn.innerHTML=label;},1600); },function(){ btn.textContent=tr('Press Ctrl+C','Ctrl+C চাপুন'); setTimeout(function(){btn.innerHTML=label;},2400); });
    });
  });

  /* brief builder */
  var org=document.getElementById('b-org'), svc=document.getElementById('b-svc'), tm=document.getElementById('b-time'), note=document.getElementById('b-note'), out=document.getElementById('b-out'), st=document.getElementById('b-status');
  function build(){
    var t;
    if(lang==='bn'){
      t='প্রিয় রুমেল,\n\nআমি '+org.options[org.selectedIndex].text+' থেকে লিখছি।\nসহায়তার বিষয়: '+svc.options[svc.selectedIndex].text+'\nসময়সীমা: '+tm.options[tm.selectedIndex].text;
      if(note.value.trim()) t+='\nবিস্তারিত: '+note.value.trim();
      t+='\n\nএকটি ছোট কলে কাজের পরিধি ও সময় নিয়ে কথা বলা যাবে কি?\n\nধন্যবাদ।';
    } else {
      t='Hello Rumel,\n\nI am writing from '+org.options[org.selectedIndex].text+'. I need help with '+svc.options[svc.selectedIndex].text+', '+tm.options[tm.selectedIndex].text+'.';
      if(note.value.trim()) t+='\n\nDetails: '+note.value.trim();
      t+='\n\nCould we arrange a short call to talk about scope and timing?\n\nThank you.';
    }
    out.value=t;
  }
  [org,svc,tm,note].forEach(function(e){ e.addEventListener('input',build); });
  document.getElementById('b-copy').addEventListener('click',function(){
    copyFrom(out,function(){ st.textContent=tr('Copied. Paste it into an email or a LinkedIn message.','কপি হয়েছে। ইমেইল বা লিংকডইন বার্তায় পেস্ট করুন।'); },function(){ st.textContent=tr('Message selected. Press Ctrl+C or long-press to copy.','বার্তা নির্বাচিত হয়েছে। কপি করতে Ctrl+C চাপুন বা চেপে ধরুন।'); });
  });

  /* apply language */
  var langBtn=document.getElementById('lang');
  function applyLang(){
    document.documentElement.lang=lang;
    keyed.forEach(function(el){
      var k=el.getAttribute('data-k');
      el.innerHTML=(lang==='bn'&&BN[k]!==undefined)?BN[k]:EN[k];
    });
    phNote.placeholder=PH[lang];
    langBtn.textContent=(lang==='bn')?'English':'বাংলা';
    langBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',tr('Switch language','ভাষা বদলান'));
    drawGantt();
    groups.forEach(function(f){ f(); });
    build();
    st.textContent='';
  }
  langBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
    lang=(lang==='bn')?'en':'bn';
    try{ localStorage.setItem('lang',lang); }catch(e){}
    applyLang();
  });
  applyLang();
})();
</script>
